notes.title: New Map, New Items & More
notes.content: [p][b]Brainrot Karters, new update is out now. Apologies for the delay.[/b][/p][h1]New Karts[/h1][h3]There is 2 new kart options[/h3][p]We have DJ Khaled kart (worst kart in the game) and Smurf Cat Kart[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45661106/1fa93edc8acc3cbed8ee5cc57d9bc56a135ef4e5.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45661106/1ff02c3a88db0861472fda074aabb3423a71ffbb.png"][/img][/p][h1]New Map[/h1][h3]Brand new map is out now, this is "Sussy Space" [/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45661106/06d410779f62ba97da0fc14fa4b3369d1eee87eb.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1]New Items[/h1][h3]5 new items have been added[/h3][list][*][p][b]My mother ate fries[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Vines[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Boy its just alkahal[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]67[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Bear 5[/b][/p][/*][/list][h1]Lap Counter[/h1][h3]There is now a lap counter slider, you can set the lap count from 1 to 6[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45661106/3541e93a793fae35238ad80ff3ac62b5f808ba72.png"][/img][/p][h1]New Achievements[/h1][h3]2 Brand new achievements:[/h3][list][*][p]Vines[/p][/*][*][p]67 (get hit by 67 projectile)[/p][/*][/list][h1]Other changes[/h1][h3]We made a UI change in the join lobby section, you can now change your server region from there:[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45661106/15124e99878e6f3c9000eb21c46c28083379111e.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Another UI change is that it will say your final time on the results screen.[/b][/p][p][/p][h1]Clankers[/h1][h3]We are working on bringing clankers into the game.[/h3][p]It is a lot harder than we expected but we will try and bring out an offline mode where you can play with bots soon.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for playing.[/p][p]Please join the discord and follow all socials.[/p]

notes.title: New items!
notes.content: [p]Hello again Brainrot Karters, another new update which includes some new items and achievements[/p][p][/p][h1]New Items[/h1][p]Here is the list of new items in the game[/p][list][*][p]Labubu[/p][/*][*][p]Polish Fazbear[/p][/*][*][p]Did unc snap?[/p][/*][*][p]Eeffoc[/p][/*][*][p]Adrian, explain our friend group[/p][/*][*][p]Barbershop haircut that costs a quarter[/p][/*][*][p]Joe Bartolozzi[/p][/*][*][p]Doakes (But you can't prove it meme)[/p][/*][*][p]Heheheha[/p][/*][/list][h2]New Achievements[/h2][p]2 new achievements are now in the game (more on the way)[/p][list][*][p]Did unc snap[/p][/*][*][p]Locked in alien[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Community items (coming soon)[/h2][p]Once it has been approved, Brainrot Kart will have community items such as trading cards, backgrounds, badges and emoticons 🔥[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for playing Brainrot Kart 🔥[/p][p][/p][p]If you want to find some people to play with, join the discord![/p]

notes.title: New Maps
notes.content: [p]Hello skibidi's new update for you[/p][p][/p][h1]3 New Maps[/h1][h2]"Played these games before"[/h2][h2]"Stairway to Mewing"[/h2][h2]"Ohio Oval"[/h2][p][/p][p][b]Just maps for today but there should be another update tomorrow with new items and achievements 🔥[/b][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3]Join the discord below if you want to find some people to play with [/h3]

notes.title: New Update (04/08)
notes.content: [p]Hello Skibidi's, Brainrot Kart has a new update again.[/p][p][/p][p]Here is all the new stuff added + bug fixes:[/p][h1]New Karts[/h1][p]There is now 2 new karts in the game, launch the game and find out what they are👅🔥[/p][p][/p][h1]New items[/h1][p]There is 6 brand new items including:[/p][p]Low Taper Fade[/p][p]Super Idol[/p][p]Goofy ahh video[/p][p]Bing Chilling[/p][p]Satisfying Video[/p][p]Don Pollo[/p][p][/p][h2]New Achievements[/h2][p]There is 2 new achievements, go get them you sigmas[/p][p][/p][h2]Linux Support[/h2][p]Linux should now be supported with this peak game, if you encounter any issues please join the discord or make a disccusion on the community hub.[/p][p][/p][h2]Bug Fixes + Changes[/h2][p]Fixed a couple of bugs with the cameras[/p][p]The Backrooms has new music[/p][p]Projectiles now go through objects such as the checkpoints and doesn't bounce off[/p][p]There is now usernames above player's karts[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Update
notes.content: [p][b]Hello Skibidi's, new update for Brainrot Kart[/b][/p][p][/p][h1]Lobby List[/h1][p][b]There is now a lobby list browser meaning you can find public lobbies that are available (if you don't see any, try changing your server region)[/b][/p][p][/p][h1]New items & bug fixes[/h1][p][b]There are 3 new items in the game:[/b][/p][p]Eye Of Rah[/p][p]Property in egypt[/p][p]Locked In Alien[/p][p][/p][p]All items sounds now play correctly[/p][p]Flashbang item now works (it will flash all other players)[/p][p][/p][h1]Changes to projectiles[/h1][p][b]You can now throw projectiles backwards by looking behind you (default key: alt) and then using item.[/b][/p][p][b]Projectiles are now faster[/b][/p][p][/p][h1]Timers[/h1][p][b]Timers are now in the races and shows times for each lap.[/b][/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/BuzJb2Z.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Sorry for the delayed update, we just had to get the matchmaking system up and running again.[/p][p][/p][p]Please join the discord and follow socials below[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Some bugs
notes.content:
There was a bug with continue button on results screen where the host couldn't click it, this should now be fixed.

We have temporarily removed the quick match button due to a bug, we will fix and add back ASAP.
For now please use session codes, if you want to join some people please join the discord:
[url=https://discord.gg/Fr3FB9dp8E]Discord[/url]
